Targets for 2030: A world where viral hepatitis transmission is halted and everyone living with viral hepatitis has access to safe, affordable and effective prevention, care and treatment services
Eliminate viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030

Indicators: Prevalence of chronic HBV infection among children aged under 5 years
Hepatitis B: Number of new chronic HBV infections per year
Hepatitis C: Number of new HCV infections per year
Hepatitis C: Percentage of people who inject drugs newly infected per year
Hepatitis B: Number of HBV-related deaths per year
Hepatitis C: Number of HCV-related deaths per year
Hepatitis B timely birth-dose vaccine: Percentage of neonates vaccinated
Hepatitis B third-dose vaccine: Percentage of infants vaccinated
Hepatitis B: Percentage of people with chronic infection diagnosed
Hepatitis B: Percentage of eligible people with chronic infection treated
Hepatitis C: Percentage of people with HCV infection diagnosed
Hepatitis C: Percentage of eligible people with HCV infection treated
Harm reduction: Number of needles and syringes distributed per person who injects drugs
Blood safety: Percentage of donated blood units screened for bloodborne diseases
Safe injections: Percentage of injections in health care facilities that are safe
